text:
jordy: quick convo about the Private setup wizard Thinking about the network step layout. Current mock shows breadcrumb under live probe logs and it reads noisy on smaller screens. Opinions? neha: breadcrumb at top. users scan top-to-bottom; if logs stream they steal attention. make logs collapsed by default with a small row count preview. :mag: frank: totally. also, when probes auto-run on field edits the primary button flips between "Run probes" and "Next" which is disorienting. propose we disable "Next" until probes are idle or successful. aria: accessibility checklist: aria-live region for progress updates (polite), visible focus outline on the show-details toggle, and avoid moving content above the current focus when logs expand. example aria: ```
Probes: 2/4 passed
``` jordy: good call. small visual nit: breadcrumb links are currently styled like CTAs. switch them to a muted text style and lighter chevrons so they don't compete with primary actions. neha: also add a tiny info icon next to breadcrumb with hover text: "Use back to review previous configuration; returning may reset step inputs." keeps expectations clear. frank: for auto-probe behavior: debounce input changes by 700ms and show a subtle spinner in the CIDR field while queued. if user explicitly clicks "Run probes" it should cancel pending auto runs and run immediately. infra-bot: alert: staging probe service had a short burst at 2025-03-12T03:12:21Z, investigating. ref=stg-probe-77. aria: keyboard order suggestion: breadcrumb -> heading -> controls -> progress -> details. On mobile collapse breadcrumb to a compact "Step 2 of 5" pill to reduce height and preserve primary CTA visibility. jordy: putting this into a dev handoff checklist: 1) breadcrumb relocated above content, muted link style 2) logs collapsed with "Show details" 3) Next disabled while probes running; explicit states for Run/Cancel 4) aria-live for progress + focus stability 5) 700ms debounce and CIDR spinner 6) mobile pill variant 7) update help tooltip copy per aria suggestion. tagging @neha for final signoff. neha: sounds good I'll review the updated mocks and drop comments on the PR. :thumbsup: frank: add final copy tweak: tooltip instead of "may reset" use "some fields may be cleared when you go back." clearer for support triage. jordy: added to checklist. thanks all!
